---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible problem with Nexora
---

For security vulnerabilities, use the [private reporting instructions](https://github.com/joe-cheung-cae/nexora/blob/main/SECURITY.md).

## What happened?

Describe the expected and actual behavior. Include relevant error output.

## How can we reproduce it?

Include the smallest case and the commands needed to reproduce the problem.

## Environment

Include the Nexora commit and the output of `nexora inspect-build`, if available. For build failures, include the OS, compiler, build preset or options, and dependency versions.
